title: AI Solutions Engineer kya banata hai
content:
AI Solutions Engineer...
ek aur CHATBOT nahi banata.
Everyone thinks this job is just writing prompts.
It is NOT.
Prompt likhna toh bas ek chhota sa hissa hai.
So what does an AI Solutions Engineer actually build?
Teen cheezein. Let me break it down.
Number one. DATA connect karna.
Company ke PDFs, CRM, support tickets, Excel sheets...
AI ko wahi data chahiye jo business ke paas already hai.
Without the right data, even the best model gives generic answers.
Aur generic answers se koi business paisa nahi kamata.
So step one is always plumbing. Boring, but critical.
Number two. A real WORKFLOW.
Example dekho.
Ek lead website pe aaya.
AI ne usse qualify kiya, CRM mein daala...
aur sales team ko Slack pe ping kiya.
No human copy-paste. No lead lost overnight.
That is the difference between a demo and a solution.
Workflow ka matlab hai... AI kisi kaam ko shuru se end tak handle kare.
Number three. SHIP it safely.
Logging. Testing. Human in the loop.
Kyunki demo banana easy hai...
PRODUCTION mein chalana asli kaam hai.
What happens when the AI is wrong?
Who checks it? How do you roll it back?
In sawaalon ka jawab dena hi is job ka core hai.
Simple rule yaad rakho.
A chatbot answers questions.
A solution SAVES hours or MAKES money.
Agar aap ye role chahte ho...
toh apne portfolio mein chatbots nahi, solutions dikhao.
Show the before and after. Show the hours saved.
Is month main ye teeno type ke projects...
public mein build kar raha hoon.
Code, bugs, aur final product... sab dikhaunga.
If you want to become an AI Solutions Engineer, build along with me.
Aur interview mein bhi yahi poocha jaata hai.
They won't ask you to write the perfect prompt.
Wo poochenge... ye system kaise banaoge, aur fail hua toh kya karoge?
Prepare for that.
Follow for daily AI, explained by a builder.
